summary: Aurelion Inc. files a Form 6-K (report of foreign private issuer) for the semi-annual period ended March 31, 2026. The filing is a routine periodic report, not a special situation. It contains standard disclosures such as financial statements, warrant and equity issuances under previous agreements (PIPE, S-8 incentive plan, consulting agreements), an acquisition agreement from August 2024 (already past), and subsequent events from late April 2026. No new M&A, tender offer, activist campaign, or other special situation event is announced. As a Hong Kong-based finance services company, this 6-K serves as the equivalent of a quarterly report under US rules with no transformative corporate action.
